problem: Manual audio saved successfully but its result was discarded by the Settings flow, leaving no completion message or direct review action.
change: Capture a separate parent-owned audio completion from the committed result. Keep its original profile and distinguish normal reuse. Explicit review refreshes the library, focuses the exact row including unavailable audio, and retains a retryable error on failed refresh/missing ID. A completed result survives page and profile navigation; next manual preparation replaces its summary. Reveal Settings completion above the player without moving focus and visibly outline the reviewed row. No audition, selection or scheduling starts automatically.

decision.pair: Steve and Elena, independent read-only proposals plus one challenge/revision
decision.initial: Steve proposed reusing manualPreparation for completion; Elena proposed a separate parent-owned record captured in mutationFn.
decision.revised: Both supported the separate record to preserve operation/interruption semantics and capture a result before refresh or page unmount. Both supported reviewing an unavailable take for its existing script/recovery guidance.
decision.coordinator: Root implemented the separate record. On failed refetch, remain in the current view with a retained result and retryable error; Steve had suggested navigating to Saved audio with a freshness warning instead.
decision.review: Elena found a missing focus-visible outline; it was fixed and verified natively. Her final artifact review found no new actionable issue.
decision.querySemantics: Local TanStack queryClient.ts catches ordinary default refetch errors. Existing mutation refresh/error lifecycle was retained; no hypothetical refresh-exception fix was added.

scope.voiceOutput: substituted with a real saved MP3
controlledFaults: omitted result ID in read response
hold voice response during page unmount

limitations: Controlled engineering evidence, not observed listener usability or live voice quality.
Real MP3 clocks advanced while muted; no audible-quality claim follows.
No additional macOS versions, physical media keys, VoiceOver, smaller windows or enlarged zoom covered.
Earlier Q10 shutdown diagnostic remains unattributed/open.
T07 Controlled combines current generation/comparison with the dated script-replacement native record; it is not an overall UX acceptance percentage.
